texts.text: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד׃

texts.reference: Shema Barukh Shem line (standalone; preceded by small Rashi-script rubric בלחש)
texts.text: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃

texts.reference: Deuteronomy 6:6 (beginning; breaks after עַל־ at the end of the crop)
texts.text: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־

uncertainties: שְׁמַ֖ע: ע printed enlarged; under מ there is a patach plus a curved hook to its right, read as tipcha.
אֶחָֽד: ד printed enlarged; under ח there is a qamatz with a short vertical stroke, read as silluq/meteg; the sof pasuq is printed as two diamond-shaped dots.
יְהוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד: a small isolated vertical mark between the words, read as paseq.
יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל: under א there is a tsere plus a mark read as etnachta; the caret shape is not clearly resolved.
The Divine Name is printed יְהוָה (shva under yod, qamatz under vav) with no holam visible, in all three occurrences on this page.
Barukh Shem line: I saw no cantillation on any word. A faint mark may sit near the ר of בָּרוּךְ and under וָעֶד, but I could not confirm it as an accent.
וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֔: next to the qamatz under א there is a short vertical stroke, read as meteg (low confidence); there are dots above ת, read as zaqef qatan.
בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֥ / וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖: the marks under final ך are slanted strokes. I can't reliably tell merkha from tipcha apart at this resolution.
וְהָי֞וּ: two strokes above י, read as gershayim.
אֲשֶׁ֨ר: a stroke above ש on its left side, read as qadma/azla.
אָנֹכִ֧י and מְצַוְּךָ֛: below-letter accents read as darga and tevir; shapes are small and uncertain.

texts.text: לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

texts.reference: Deuteronomy 11:13 (side note in small type: דברים יא יג; the last line's below-letter pointing is cut off at the bottom of the crop)
texts.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אתכם היּוֹם לאהבה֞ את־יהוה אלֹהיכם֙ ולעבדוֹ בּכל־

uncertainties: Last line (אתכם … בכל־): everything below the letters is cut off. I give only consonants, dagesh, holam, and the above-letter accents I could see: gershayim over לאהבה and pashta over final ם of אלהיכם. All vowels below the letters on this line are unread. s20-middle shows only unalignable fragments of them.
וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם: a dot/stroke above, between ק and ש, read as the shin dot and not an accent.
לְא֖וֹת: a mark above א read as holam; the mark under ל is unclear.
מְזֻז֥וֹת: printed defective, with qubbutz (three slanted dots) under the first ז and no vav.
בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ (6:9): the mark under ת might be an etnachta-like wedge. Read as tipcha, low confidence.
בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤: a '<'-shaped mark under ך, read as mahpakh.
בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙: two pashta-like strokes, one over ת and one over the end of ך.
מִצְוֹתַ֔י: holam dot over the vav area (written here as U+05B9).

texts.text: לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
וְנָתַתִּ֥י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃
וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן־יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַֽעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְהוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָאֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַֽאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵלֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ

uncertainties: פֶּ֥ן־יִפְתֶּ֖ה: a short horizontal stroke appears between the words, read as maqaf. Reported as printed.
וַֽעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ / וַֽאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם: next to the patach under ו there is a short mark, read as meteg (could be a qadma-like stroke); pashta over final ם of וַעֲבַדְתֶּם.
הָאָרֶץ (11:17): I could not see pashta strokes, so I left them out. The scan may print them faintly.
וְהָאֲדָמָ֔ה: zaqef dots over מ; no munach visible under ה.
אֵלֶּה (11:18): a wedge-like mark might sit under or near א. I could not resolve it, so I left it out rather than guess.
מְזוּז֥וֹת (11:20) is printed plene with shureq, unlike מְזֻז֥וֹת at 6:9. לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת (11:18) has holam-vav in the first syllable, unlike לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת at 6:8.
יְבוּלָ֑הּ: mappiq dot in the final ה; wedge under ל read as etnachta.
וְחָרָ֨ה and אַף־יְהוָ֜ה: above-letter strokes read as qadma and geresh; the exact stroke direction is uncertain.
Top line: fragments of below-letter pointing belong to the cropped last line of s20-shema (11:13) and are not transcribed.

texts.text: וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

texts.reference: Numbers 15:37 (side note in small type: במדבר טו לז)
texts.text: וַֽיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָתְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם

uncertainties: עַ֚ל: a short angled stroke under/next to the patach under ע, read as yetiv. Low confidence.
After הָאֲדָמָ֔ה and after יְהוָ֛ה (11:21) there may be small vertical marks that could be paseq. I could not confirm them, so they are not transcribed.
לָכֶם֮: a horizontal wavy stroke over final ם, read as zarqa. לְצִיצִת֒: three dots in a triangle over ת, read as segolta. Both clearly visible.
לֵּאמֹֽר: dagesh visible in ל.
וַֽיֹּ֥אמֶר / וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם: a short horizontal mark next to the patach under ו, read as meteg.
דַּבֵּ֞ר: double stroke above ב, read as gershayim.

texts.text: וְלֹא תָת֜וּרוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יהוה אֱלֹהיכם׃

uncertainties: וְלֹא תָת֜וּרוּ: printed with a space and no maqaf. I could not confirm a meteg under ל. A stroke over the first ת/ו, read as geresh. The holam-vav in תָתוּרוּ is printed plene.
Last line יהוה אֱלֹהיכם׃: the below-letter pointing is cut off at the bottom of the crop. Only the holam on ל is certain; the Divine Name's vowels are not legible.
After this line there is a small Rashi-script note: יש לצרף אלהיכם לאמת, אכן יתן כוח מעט שלא יבולע הא׳. It is unpointed and not part of the verse.
וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם: hiriq under the first ו (not shva), low confidence.
מִצְוֹתָ֑י: a wedge under ת read as etnachta; holam over the vav area.
זֹנִ֖ים: holam on ז; the mark under נ is uncertain.
Top line of the crop (running head) is cut off and not transcribed.

role_label.language: Yiddish (older or non-YIVO spelling, as printed)
role_label.pointing: Only the first two letters are pointed. A short horizontal bar (rafe-like) sits above, and a qamatz-shaped mark sits below. In the crop both look nearest to the SECOND letter, which has the shape of ח (not א) as printed. The remaining letters רבעטער are unpointed. It ends with a colon-like mark.
uncertainties: The horizontal bar could belong to פ (rafe on pe, written פֿ) and just be offset to the left. In the image it looks centred closer to the ח, so it could also be a mark over ח. My string puts it on פ by Unicode convention only; its visual position is ambiguous.
The qamatz is below the second letter (ח-shaped), not below פ.
Whether the second letter is a real ח or an א in a ח-like typeface can't be settled from the crop. As printed it reads ח.

limits: Resolution: below-letter conjunctive and disjunctive accents (munach, merkha, tipcha, darga, tevir, mahpakh, yetiv) are tiny at the displayed size, and many identifications rest on stroke direction and are low confidence. Above-letter accents (zaqef, pashta, gershayim, geresh, segolta, zarqa) and large features (etnachta wedges, silluq, sof pasuq) are more reliable.

Conventional-text bias: although I was told not to, my readings may be pulled toward the familiar Masoretic accentuation wherever the scan is unclear. Wherever I could not see a mark I left it out and listed it above, but any accent not specifically flagged should still be checked against higher-zoom crops.

Bottom cut-offs: the last line of s20-shema (11:13, אתכם … בכל־) and the last line of s22 (15:41, יהוה אלהיכם) have no legible below-letter pointing in these crops. A fresh crop is needed for those lines.
Possible paseq marks after הָאֲדָמָ֔ה and יְהוָ֛ה in 11:21 are unconfirmed.

Overlaps between crops were removed at these boundaries: עַל־/לְבָבֶֽךָ (s18→s20), בּכל־/לְבַבְכֶ֖ם (s20-shema→s20-middle), בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ/וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ (s20-middle→s20-numbers), אֹתָ֑ם/וְלֹא (s20-numbers→s22).
Rubric text (יחיד אומר אֵל מֶלֶךְ נֶאֱמָן׃ on s18, the small verse-reference side notes, and the Rashi-script notes) is mentioned for context only and was not checked to the same standard.
